title: Juicy Bitter Chinese Pork Chow Fun
description: A savory and aerated Chinese dish featuring bitter flavors, garlic powder, and high-protein pork, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe is designed to be quick and easy to make.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, garlic powder, and sesame oil to make the sauce.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork loin to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside to rest.
Add the bitter melon to the skillet and cook until tender and lightly browned.
Add the cooked noodles, sauce, and green onions to the skillet and stir to combine.
Slice the pork into thin strips and add to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the ingredients are well combined and heated through.
